config.label: sevDesk API token (Settings > Users > API token)
config.description: sevDesk API token (Settings > Users > API token). It has full access to the account; ideally create it for a dedicated user. To keep it out of the client configuration, set up the server by hand with SEVDESK_API_TOKEN_KEYCHAIN (OS keychain) or SEVDESK_API_TOKEN_FILE instead: https://sevdeskmcp.lanfermann.dev/docs/en/configuration#token

config.label: Comma-separated permission tiers to enable: read, write, commit, external, or all
config.description: Comma-separated permission tiers to enable: read, write, commit, external, or all. Tools above the allowed tiers are not registered. read is always on.

config.label: Set to true to allow only read tools, whatever SEVDESK_ALLOW says
config.description: Set to true to allow only read tools, whatever SEVDESK_ALLOW says.

config.label: Set to true to make write tools only return a preview of what they would do, without sending anything
config.description: Set to true to make write tools only return a preview of what they would do, without sending anything.

config.label: How a human confirms commit and external actions: elicit (in the client), browser (local approval page) or off (also needs SEVDESK_I_UNDERSTAND_NO_CONFIRM=1)
config.description: How a human confirms commit and external actions: elicit (in the client), browser (local approval page) or off (also needs SEVDESK_I_UNDERSTAND_NO_CONFIRM=1).

config.label: Path of a local JSON Lines file that records every write the server makes (redacted)
config.description: Path of a local JSON Lines file that records every write the server makes (redacted). Unset: no audit log.

config.label: Comma-separated toolsets to load, e
config.description: Comma-separated toolsets to load, e.g. invoices,vouchers,banking. Unset loads all except advanced; all adds advanced.

config.label: Absolute folders (separated like PATH) that receipts and e-invoices may be read from, for voucher uploads and e-invoice import
config.description: Absolute folders (separated like PATH) that receipts and e-invoices may be read from, for voucher uploads and e-invoice import. Unset: no local file is read.

config.label: Folder where PDFs, e-invoice XML, CSV and DATEV exports may be saved
config.description: Folder where PDFs, e-invoice XML, CSV and DATEV exports may be saved. Unset: the file-saving tools are not offered.
